question: In Spain, the body in charge of determining the special conditions of prescription and dispensing of medicines in the National Health System (S.N.S.) is:

options.opa: The Spanish Agency of Medicines and Health Products.
options.opc: The General Directorate of the Basic Portfolio of Services of the S.N.S. and Pharmacy.
options.ope: The General Directorate of Public Health, Quality and Innovation.
